entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: When I gaze at the city from up here,[n]it looks like an entirely different world...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Change how you look at things,[n]and the game will change as well.[n]The world is like a shogi board.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: The pieces that live in the world [n]can completely change, depending[n]on the emotions of the player...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I've been so twisted by the adults[n]around me that I began to lose[n]sight of myself.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: But after I met you and we started[n]playing shogi together... my heart[n]began to change.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: Similar to this Ferris wheel...[n]You showed me a different view,[n]and changed my world...
What kind of world is that?
You can always count on me.[clr 27]

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I would say... one with a bright[n]future. *giggle* I suppose that's[n]not much of an answer.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: *giggle* Thank you.[n]Well then, that's what I'll do.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: That's fine. All it takes is[n]a single moment to overcome[n]a repetition of moves...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: And an expert hand can break through[n]any situation... That is what you are.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: From behind, all scenery looks vibrant[n]and colorful...

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: I truly love you from the depths[n]of my heart.

entries.speaker: Hifumi
entries.en: This must be how it feels[n]to be truly happy...
